scope: New independent PyTorch field-prediction implementations, not copied PCNO or paper reproduction

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
3D U-Net: Learning Dense Volumetric Segmentation from Sparse Annotation

adaptations: CNN: four hidden 3-kernel GELU layers, width16, no normalization, linear pointwise field head
ResNet18: 3-kernel stride1 stem without pool, widths16/32/64/128, basic counts2/2/2/2, linear pointwise field head, explicit interpolation to input size
Bottleneck follows torchvision v1.5 middle-convolution stride, not original v1 stride; component only, no ResNet50 training claim
UNet: three pools, base8, double same-padding GELU convolutions, bilinear/trilinear interpolation align_corners=False, no normalization, field regression
3D residual/CNN are explicit dimensional lifts; no claim to a 3D classification reference
Existing PCNO GPL implementation and checkpoints unchanged
reference: reference_spatial.py independently reconstructs agreed variants with torch primitives and imports no Dojo computational modules
